cards.ex: You need to work hard if you want to get ahead in this company.
cards.exUz: Agar siz bu kompaniyada muvaffaqiyatga erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qattiq mehnat qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ishda yoki hayotda boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: She really rose to the challenge and finished the project on time.
cards.exUz: U haqiqatan ham qiyinchilikka dosh berdi va loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilikni muvaffaqiyatli yengish.

cards.ex: He always goes the extra mile for his clients.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'z mijozlari uchun qo'shimcha harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy talablardan ko'ra ko'proq harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The school helps students reach their full potential.
cards.exUz: Maktab o'quvchilarga o'z imkoniyatlarini to'liq ishga solishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining barcha qobiliyatlarini to'liq rivojlantirish va ishlatish.

cards.ex: Winning the award was a real feather in her cap.
cards.exUz: Mukofotni yutish uning uchun haqiqiy faxrlanishga arziydigan narsa edi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyat yoki yutuq, faxrlanishga arziydigan narsa.

cards.ex: They hit the jackpot when they invested in that company.
cards.exUz: Ular o'sha kompaniyaga sarmoya kiritganda omadlari chopdi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan omadga erishish, katta yutuqqa erishish.

cards.ex: Scientists have made a breakthrough in cancer research.
cards.exUz: Olimlar saraton kasalligini tadqiq qilishda katta yutuqqa erishdilar.
cards.uzDef: Muhim kashfiyot yoki yutuqqa erishish.

cards.ex: If you keep working hard, you're on the right track to success.
cards.exUz: Agar siz qattiq mehnat qilishda davom etsangiz, muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun to'g'ri yo'ldasiz.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri yo'nalishda harakatlanayotgan, muvaffaqiyat sari.

cards.ex: Her research paved the way for new treatments.
cards.exUz: Uning tadqiqotlari yangi davolash usullari uchun yo'l ochdi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda boshqalarga osonroq bo'lishi uchun sharoit yaratish.

cards.ex: He's determined to climb the ladder in the company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyada lavozimda ko'tarilishga qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Ishda yoki tashkilotda yuqori lavozimlarga ko'tarilish.

cards.ex: Hard work and dedication are a recipe for success.
cards.exUz: Qattiq mehnat va sadoqat muvaffaqiyat retseptidir.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga olib keladigan narsalarning kombinatsiyasi.

cards.ex: The team set the bar high with their performance.
cards.exUz: Jamoa o'z faoliyati bilan yuqori standart o'rnatdi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori standartlar o'rnatish, boshqalarga yaxshiroq bo'lishga undash.

cards.ex: The company has gone from strength to strength in recent years.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya so'nggi yillarda kuchdan kuchga kirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan yaxshilanib, muvaffaqiyatliroq bo'lish.

cards.ex: After years of hard work, they are finally reaping the rewards.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik mehnatdan so'ng, ular nihoyat mevasini yemoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Qilingan mehnatning natijasidan foydalanish.

cards.ex: With hard work and dedication, you can achieve your goals.
cards.exUz: Qattiq mehnat va sadoqat bilan siz o'z maqsadingizga erishishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'z oldiga qo'ygan maqsadlarga erishish.

cards.ex: The project is making strides towards completion.
cards.exUz: Loyiha yakunlanish sari katta qadamlar tashlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Katta yutuqlarga erishish, sezilarli o'zgarishlar qilish.

cards.ex: She felt on top of the world after winning the competition.
cards.exUz: U musobaqada g'alaba qozonganidan keyin o'zini dunyoda eng baxtli his qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini juda baxtli va muvaffaqiyatli his qilish.

cards.ex: They decided to take the plunge and start their own business.
cards.exUz: Ular tavakkal qilishga va o'z bizneslarini boshlashga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki xavfli qaror qabul qilish, tavakkalga qo'l urish.

cards.ex: She broke the mold and became a successful female engineer.
cards.exUz: U stereotiplarni buzdi va muvaffaqiyatli ayol muhandis bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: An'anaviy yoki odatiy usullardan farqli ravishda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The event was a resounding success.
cards.exUz: Tadbir katta muvaffaqiyat bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va aniq muvaffaqiyat.

cards.ex: She excels in mathematics.
cards.exUz: U matematikani a'lo darajada o'zlashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsada juda yaxshi bo'lish, a'lo natijalarga erishish.

cards.ex: He wants to make a name for himself in the music industry.
cards.exUz: U musiqa sanoatida nom qozonmoqchi.
cards.uzDef: O'z sohasida mashhur va hurmatga sazovor bo'lish.

cards.ex: If you work hard, you will reap what you sow.
cards.exUz: Agar qattiq mehnat qilsangiz, nima eksang shuni o'rasan.
cards.uzDef: Qilgan harakatlaringizning natijasini ko'rasiz.

cards.ex: With your talent, the sky's the limit.
cards.exUz: Sizning iste'dodingiz bilan, chegara yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Imkoniyatlar chegarasiz, hech qanday cheklov yo'q.

cards.ex: He's a talented young man who's going places.
cards.exUz: U iste'dodli yigit, uning yaxshi kelajagi bor.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoniyati bor.

cards.ex: She really knocked it out of the park with her presentation.
cards.exUz: U o'z taqdimoti bilan juda zo'r ish qildi.
cards.term: knock it out of the park
cards.uzDef: Judayam yaxshi natijaga erishish, zo'r ish qilish.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu loyihani boshlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror loyihani yoki ishni boshlash.

cards.ex: This job is just a stepping stone to bigger things.
cards.exUz: Bu ish faqat kattaroq narsalar uchun tramplin.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatga erishishga yordam beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: She's finally fulfilling her potential as an artist.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat rassom sifatida o'z salohiyatini ro'yobga chiqarmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'zining barcha qobiliyatlarini ishga solib, maqsadga erishish.

cards.ex: He's come a long way since he started learning English.
cards.exUz: U ingliz tilini o'rgana boshlaganidan beri uzoq yo'l bosib o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi holatidan ancha yaxshilanish, katta yutuqlarga erishish.
